title: Pokemon TCG Onix Scarlet & Violet 090/182 Reverse Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Onix card from the Scarlet & Violet set is a must-have for any Pokémon TCG collector. With its Fighting color attribute and Stage 1 stage, this card packs a punch in any battle. The card is made from high-quality card stock and has a Reverse Holo finish, making it a stunning addition to any collection.

The card is in standard size and has an HP of 140. It is an Uncommon card and has the card number 090/182. The Onix card is in English language and manufactured by Nintendo in the United States. This card features Onix, a legendary character, and is perfect for fans of the Pokémon franchise.
